subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.

A true friend always _______, but a selfish friend tries to __mislead__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. guides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"mislead"** means to cause someone to have a wrong idea or impression about someone or something. (गुमराह करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The advertisement was designed to mislead consumers into thinking they were getting a bargain.
 
 
 
• **"Guide"** refers to showing or indicating the way to someone; it is the opposite of mislead. (मार्गदर्शन करना)
 
 
• **Example: **A teacher's role is to guide students through their academic journey.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'mislead'** is **'guide'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. guides**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deplores** (निंदा करना): To express strong disapproval of something.

 
 
• **Example:** She deplores violence of any kind.
 
 
 
• **Deludes** (धोखा देना): To impose a misleading belief upon someone; to deceive.
 
 
• **Example: **He deludes himself into thinking he can quit smoking whenever he wants.
 
 
 
• **Imbibes** (अवशोषित करना): To absorb or assimilate ideas or knowledge.
 
 
• **Example:** She imbibes new information with great enthusiasm.
 
 

5a:Tcd3,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
